newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM says Mt Isa metal deliveries to resume.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM says Mt Isa metal deliveries to resume.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd said deliveries of copper and zinc concentrate and lead bullion will resume immediately following the opening of road links between Mt Isa and the port of Townsville in north Queensland.
"The road is open and deliveries will resume forthwith," MIM general manager, public affairs, Collin Myers told Reuters.
"We are also expecting that the rail link from Mt Isa to be open on Thursday," he said.
MIM's deliveries of its Mt Isa metals production were stopped late last week when both rail and road links were cut by flood waters following torrential rain caused by severe cyclonic low pressures.
"It (the flooding) has had some, but not a substantial, effect, on deliveries," Myers said.
A Department of Natural Resources spokesman said the flood waters that had inundated large areas surrounding Cloncurry and Mt Isa were a "one in 500-years rainfall event."
